## 1. Vision & Goals

**Vision.** ProductForge Dashboard is the API-first control plane and "face" of the ProductForge multi-agent, multi-project pipeline. Every pipeline operation — project creation, model-tier selection/customization, orchestration, monitoring, human-in-the-loop input, testing, and deployment — is exposed through one UI (web + mobile companion) and mirrored by a documented HTTP API, with a portfolio-aware AI chat companion.

**Why now.** The pipeline already works but is fragmented across CLI, files, and manual inputs. There is no unified, trustworthy, API-reusable control surface.

**What success looks like (measurable).**
- **G1 (Onboarding):** New non-CLI user creates a project and starts a run in ≤ 5 min; ≥ 90% task success in usability test. (Target metric — not yet validated. `estimate`.)
- **G2 (Coverage):** 100% of interactive pipeline inputs/selections/outputs reachable through dashboard dialogs, verified against the pipeline’s 32 stages + 4 HIL gates.
- **G3 (Concurrency & latency):** ≥ 5 concurrent projects; event→UI update ≤ 2s (p95). `estimate`.
- **G4 (Auto mode):** ≥ 90% of auto-mode runs complete end-to-end without human intervention on supported pipelines. `estimate`.
- **G5 (Adoption):** Majority of pipeline runs initiated via dashboard vs CLI within 6 months of launch. `estimate`.
- **G6 (Companion):** Text chat answers portfolio/status queries and executes core control actions (voice deferred per MVP decision).

**Non-goals.** Not a new pipeline engine, not a new LLM provider, not a generic PM tool, not agent-internal prompt surgery.

## 2. Target Users / Personas

| Persona | Role | Primary job | Success signal |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Priya — Portfolio Operator** (primary) | Tech lead / PO running several pipeline projects | Launch, watch, steer, ship many projects from one screen | Zero CLI needed; stalled runs surfaced proactively |
| **Marco — Builder-Integrator** (secondary) | Developer embedding pipeline into own tooling / CI | API-first access to the same capabilities | Can rebuild dashboard views over HTTP |
| **Sam — Mobile Supervisor** (tertiary) | Manager away from desk | Approve inputs, respond to alerts, check health | Responds to blocked run within 5 min of push |
| **Tenant Admin** (new, MVP) | Org admin | Manage teams, roles, quotas, credentials isolation | Strict tenant isolation verified by audit |
| **Anti-persona — Deep Customization Engineer** | Wants engine-internal hacks | — | Excluded; use documented agent contract instead |

## 3. Scope — Must-have vs Nice-to-have (prioritized)

**MUST (MVP — production-quality, working E2E, per owner override):**
- M1 Project intake from idea (wizard) + model tier select / customize / create.
- M2 Full E2E orchestration per project (start / pause / resume / stop / resume-from-checkpoint) covering all 32 stages + 4 gates.
- M3 Multi-project portfolio (create / list / run in parallel) + capacity management.
- M4 Multi-project orchestration across all agents.
- M5 Real-time agent/orchestrator monitoring, streaming logs, per-stage artifacts, tokens/cost.
- M6 HIL dialog console: every interactive prompt as a dialog (gates, approvals, 360° discovery panel).
- M7 Advanced auto mode (unattended E2E with human-proxy decisions + live logs).
- M8 Work management: backlog, defects/issues, approvals, audit trail.
- M9 Quality surface: QA cycles, Go/No-Go, compliance, traceability, test framework integration.
- M10 Complete representation of backend: all modules, 32 stages + 4 gates, 19 leads / 55 agent cards, all configs, all 120 registered stores (read-only views; actions routed to owner modules).
- M11 Intake API + adapters (ChatGPT / Claude+MCP / Gemini extension / generic) + routing + compile/approve + backlog promotion.
- M12 Multi-tenant teams, roles (owner/admin/create/read-only), per-user/tenant capacity quotas via `core/capacity.py` context.
- M13 API-first surface (reuse pipeline APIs + dashboard-specific additions) with versioned contract.
- M14 Deployment: Vercel-compatible frontend; backend co-located or split; documented topologies.
- M15 Text AI chat companion (portfolio/project aware; can query and trigger actions).
- M16 Presentations / marketing / video generator UIs (owner-added).

**NICE (deferred until M1–M16 stable):**
- N1 Voice AI companion (wake-word + STT/TTS, English) — refer to mymoney project implementation.
- N2 Native mobile app companion.
- N3 Non-English i18n.
- N4 Ops / post-production console.
- N5 Broader external API catalog.
- N6 Cost/token analytics beyond basic per-project view.
- N7 Config change history with revert.
- N8 Command palette / keyboard shortcut suite.

## 5. Business Model Grounding (KB citations)

> Citations reference `config/business-models-kb.json` entry ids. Where an entry could not be confirmed, it is marked **`needs_research`** — not invented.

**Revenue model.**
- Adopted: **`revenue_models:saaS_seat_based`** (per-seat subscription for Portfolio Operators + Tenant Admins) with a secondary **`revenue_models:usage_based`** component for LLM tokens/agent-hours passed through at cost+margin.
- Rationale: outcome (pipeline runs) is usage-correlated; seats capture operational value; usage captures variable cost. `estimate` on margin; actuals to be measured post-launch.
- **Flag `needs_research`:** a hybrid seat+usage entry specifically for developer-tooling SaaS was **not confirmed** in the KB — pricing-strategist should validate the exact blend pre-GA.

**Pricing tactics.**
- Adopted: **`pricing_tactics:value_based_tiering`** (Free / Team / Business / Enterprise) plus **`pricing_tactics:annual_discount`**.
- Enterprise tier includes SSO, audit export, and self-hosted deployment (justifies premium).
- **Flag `needs_research`:** entry id for “self-hosted enterprise uplift” not confirmed; treat price points as `estimate` pending competitive scan.

**Unit economics.**
- Adopted framing: **`unit_economics:gross_margin_by_segment`** — track per-tenant gross margin = (subscription + usage markup) − (LLM cost + infra + support).
- Guardrail: **`unit_economics:payback_period_cac`** — target payback ≤ 12 months `estimate`.
- **Flag `needs_research`:** no KB entry confirmed for “multi-tenant agent-platform infra cost model”; needs research before committing margin targets.

**GTM playbooks.**
- Adopted: **`gtm_playbooks:developer_led_growth`** — pipeline users already exist; dashboard is the natural adoption path. Secondary **`gtm_playbooks:product_led_onboarding`** (self-serve wizard → first run in ≤ 5 min).
- **Flag `needs_research`:** an entry specific to “internal-tool → external SaaS conversion” was not confirmed.

**Growth loops.**
- Adopted: **`growth_loops:tooling_virality`** — dashboard screenshots, shared API surface, and embedded API calls create passive exposure; plus **`growth_loops:content_referral`** via published pipeline comparison metrics (opt-in, no customer data).
- **Flag `needs_research`:** “API-as-distribution” loop entry not confirmed as a distinct id.

**Market sizing.**
- Method: **`market_sizing:bottom_up_tam`** seeded from ProductForge pipeline’s own active-user count + adjacent multi-agent builder populations.
- **No market numbers are asserted here.** Any figure used downstream must be labeled `estimate` and traceable to a source. Current state: **`needs_research`** — requires a dedicated sizing pass.

**Competition frameworks.**
- Adopted: **`competition_frameworks:positioning_matrix`** (axes: orchestration breadth vs API-first openness) and **`competition_frameworks:jobs_to_be_done`** when evaluating substitutes (CLI, LangSmith-style tracing tools, generic PM tools).
- **Flag `needs_research`:** no confirmed entry for “agent-platform control-plane” vertical; positioning narrative is provisional.

## 6. Constraints, Risks, Assumptions

**Constraints.**
- Backend pipeline is source of truth (R3); dashboard must not duplicate state.
- Tech stack: **unspecified by brief** — no framework/DB/auth choices are introduced in this document.
- MVP must ship multi-tenancy complete (not designed-only) and support both co-located and split deployment.

**Assumptions (each labeled).**
- A1 The existing pipeline exposes stable internal APIs usable by the dashboard (`assumption`, per 0a Discovery).
- A2 Concurrent-project ceiling of ≥ 5 is achievable with current backend (`estimate`).
- A3 Vercel-hosted frontend can reach a self-hosted backend without protocol changes (`assumption`).
- A4 mymoney project’s voice implementation is reusable for deferred N1 (`assumption`; verify scope before committing).
- A5 Seat+usage pricing is acceptable to target users (`assumption`; validate via pricing-strategist research — see §5 flags).

**Risks (top).**
- **R-1 (High) Real-time streaming scale** — many projects × agents × logs. Mitigate: multiplexing, backpressure, sampling. (From 0_ideation R-1.)
- **R-2 (High) Scope breadth** — web + mobile + voice + tests + deployment + API in one MVP. Mitigate: strict must/nice split and phased delivery (§7).
- **R-3 (High) Multi-tenant isolation correctness** — cross-tenant leak is a launch-blocking defect. Mitigate: audit logging, contract tests, red-team pass before GA.
- **R-4 (Med) Backend/dashboard contract drift.** Mitigate: versioned contract + contract tests.
- **R-5 (Med) Auto-mode failure loops.** Mitigate: retry policy + abort conditions + prominent alerts.
- **R-6 (Med) Voice reliability (deferred).** Mitigate: feature-detect + text fallback when N1 lands.

## 7. Suggested Phasing for Delivery

- **Phase 1 — Core control plane (must):** KF-1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Portfolio, wizard, tier mgmt, E2E orchestration, HIL dialogs, live monitoring/logs.
- **Phase 2 — Multi-project + auto mode + work/quality (must):** KF-4, 10; work mgmt, QA/Go-No-Go, test framework integration.
- **Phase 3 — Intake + multitenancy + API + deploy (must):** KF-11, 12, 13; adapters, routing, quotas, Vercel/co-located deployment.
- **Phase 4 — Text chat companion + presentations/marketing/video UIs (must):** KF-14 + M16.
- **Phase 5 — Nice-to-have:** voice (N1), mobile companion (N2), i18n (N3), ops console (N4), broader API catalog (N5), analytics/command palette (N6–N8).

Gate each phase on: (a) functional + NFR + security test suites green, (b) Go/No-Go review passed, (c) 0 critical tenant-isolation findings.
